title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings continued mixing the live album Wings Over America on 17 November 1976.

On this day, the 12th of 13 mixing sessions, the songs ‘Band On The Run’ and ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’ were worked on. Both had been recorded on 7 June 1976 at the McNichols Sports Arena in Denver.
